meta.title: The International 2026
meta.note: Group stage & main event fields fill in as regional qualifiers conclude (June 28).

prizePool.note: $1,600,000 base plus $1,736,352 from supporter bundle sales (30% of each bundle). No Battle Pass or Compendium in 2026.

groupStage.note: Top three go straight to the playoffs. 4th-13th play an elimination round for five more slots. 14th-16th are out. Field finalized after qualifiers (June 28).

bracket.format: Double elimination — eight teams out of the group stage · Aug 20-23
bracket.note: Bracket fills in once the group stage and its elimination round are done.
